prose: The ancient key bites into the tarnished lock with a harsh metallic screech. Rust flakes scatter across the cold flagstones as the tumblers finally yield. With a groaning heave, the heavy iron portcullis rises, revealing the damp, shadowed expanse of the antechamber beyond.

new_facts.fact: The rusted iron portcullis was successfully unlocked using the engraved silver key.

lore_citations.snippet: The lower portcullises were forged with dual tumblers keyed to imperial silver ward keys.
